x: So a great day for Belgrave and Oliver having the satisfaction of adding his name to a cup with such greats as Chris Chataway (1949), Tim Johnson (1959), Dave Holt (1964), Pete Standing (1968), Dave Clarke (1977) and Roger Hackney (1978).

Heavy points scorers for us during the year were the usual mob - Mike Small, Joe Minetti and Mike Bazire (but we could have done with Joe and Mike B in the Final relay!) Some good 3000's from John Wright, Matt Chaston and, in a surprise turnout, John Gladwin having a time trial with Dave Clarke.

The previous week he had looked invincible in the Surrey League race, beating Dave Clarke and Simon Rayner handsomely, but here, suffering from a sinus problem, he struggled to come home 33rd and Hercules Wimbledon's Rayner got his own back to the extent of 51 seconds.
